description: We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our environment remains safe for all residents and staff.In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for staff, fostering continuous professional growth, and maintaining compliance with all infection control protocols. Your expertise will directly contribute to the quality of care and overall well-being within our facility, making a significant impact on our community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care, infection control, and staff education
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
